title: PWA iPhone home-screen app: too big a gap above the header
body:
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1617981a-21e8-4d7b-9954-aecaecb2c848)

<!-- GRILL-ME-UNDERSTANDING-START -->
## Current Understanding

In the GRQ-AutoTrader PWA installed as an iPhone home-screen app (screenshot 11 Oct 16:34 AEDT, Home screen, v1.21.8 · 4be36c8), there is too big a gap above the header: a blank band between the bottom of the iOS status bar and the top of the header (AutoTrader wordmark plus Stop / Manual / Auto). The gap above the header must shrink to 0–12px, without bringing back the GRQ-AutoTrader#2711 bug where the header sat under the status bar and could not be tapped.

Facts found: the code lives in `stSoftwareAU/GRQ-AutoTrader`, not this repo. `web/public/app.css` line 12 sets `--status-bar-strip-height: max(62px, env(safe-area-inset-top))` (from #2711). Under `@media (max-width: 575.98px) and (display-mode: standalone)` (line 522), a fixed `body::before` strip of that height is painted, `body` pads down by it, and `.grq-header` adds `padding-top: min(env(safe-area-inset-top), 0.75rem)` (line 538); the header's `max-height` also subtracts the strip (line 644). The shell uses `viewport-fit=cover` with `apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style=black` (`web/build/index_html.ts`). Likely cause (unverified): the 62px floor plus the header's own top padding stack on top of the space iOS already reserves. The existing browser test is `e2e/header_footer_pinned.ts`.

### Accepted scope so far

- The fix lands in `stSoftwareAU/GRQ-AutoTrader`; a human transfers this issue there before work starts (the Vibe Coder cannot transfer issues).
- In the home-screen app below 576px, the gap above the header (status bar's bottom edge to the header's top edge) measures 0–12px, and the header's top edge is never above the status bar's bottom edge.
- `e2e/header_footer_pinned.ts` asserts that 0–12px gap at simulated top insets of 0, 47 and 59px, and asserts Stop, Manual and Auto each respond to a tap at those insets.
- Done when that e2e test passes in CI and the user confirms on their iPhone, after deploy, that the blank band above the header is gone.

### Open questions

None.

### Assumptions

- Fix lands in GRQ-AutoTrader via a transfer of this issue — accepted by default in Round 1.
- Target gap above the header is 0–12px, not exactly 0px — accepted by default in Round 1.
- The version footer (`v1.21.8 · 4be36c8`) overlapping "IBKR observation refreshed" on Home is out of scope; it goes in a separate GRQ-AutoTrader issue (none open yet) — accepted by default in Round 1.
- Done = the e2e test at 0, 47 and 59px insets plus an on-device check after deploy — accepted by default in Round 1.
- Safari-tab layout and desktop (992px and wider) layout render unchanged.

### Related open issues

- GRQ-AutoTrader#2711 (closed) — introduced the 62px strip; this fix must not regress it.
- GRQ-AutoTrader#3158 — pull-to-refresh 80px from the top shares the top-of-page area; it must keep working.
- No overlapping open issue in stSoftwareAU/VibeCoder.
<!-- GRILL-ME-UNDERSTANDING-END -->
